mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shop ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM shop ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop (code, name, phone, address, shop_lat, shop_lng, status, sort) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{shopLat}, #{shopLng}, #{status}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE shop SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, shop_lat = #{shopLat}, shop_lng = #{shopLng}, sort = #{sort} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE shop SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
